He completed his PhD in George Church’s lab, where he developed a cell rejuvenation discovery platform through the use of multiomic measurements and high throughput transcriptomic reprogramming screens. Using his platform, Alex discovered new gene therapies for rejuvenating primary human cells and mouse tissues.
